conversion.row_order: ASCII lexical order by logical operator name; exactly one row per active exact ID.
conversion.identity: operator_id is the original accepted exact evidence ID; name and version are split without aliasing, latest lookup, or substitution. A live subject must resolve that exact ID and match type.__module__, type.__name__, inspect.getsourcefile(), and the bound source SHA-256 before any case can pass.

result_projection.output_data: Preserve list/group/record order, exact key sets, JSON scalar types, and values. A tensor [[]] is not itself proof of empty or failure.
result_projection.output_attributes: Preserve exact keys and ordinary value types. Counts are nonnegative integers; bool and float do not equal an integer count.
result_projection.is_empty: Require an actual Boolean. Successful-empty requires no errors; errors with [[]] require false.
result_projection.errors: Project each error to exact code and stage. Ignore message, traceback, logs, elapsed time, cost, input_shape, and output_shape.
result_projection.floating_point: Exact by default. The accepted avg output field alone allows absolute tolerance 1e-9, zero relative tolerance, finite int/float only, and excludes bool.
result_projection.non_json_inputs: Apply only evidence-declared typed transforms or deterministic doubles; never eval arbitrary descriptors.

evidence_schemas.cases: Select by exact case id from cases[]; require case.operator_id to equal the row ID before projecting expected fields or predicates.
evidence_schemas.observations: Select by exact case id from observations[]; map result.data, result.attributes, result.meta.is_empty, and result.meta.errors while preserving the recorded side-effect assertions.
